about:
Polymer Molding Inc. (PMI) operates from Erie, Pennsylvania, as an American-owned and operated plastic injection molding manufacturer and global supplier. The company specializes in the custom design and production of protective coverings, closures, and components, with fully staffed tool-building, prototype, and mold-maintenance departments on site.

PMI produces custom injection molded parts and maintains a catalog of industry-standard caps, plugs, netting, components, and inserts for protection against contamination and shipping damage. Its capabilities include two-shot injection molding and a secondary operations department that handles bagging, labeling, hardware installation, and other finishing services. The firm also offers free samples upon request.

The company serves a global customer base requiring protective solutions, with testimonials referencing clients in Ohio, Colorado, Indiana, New York, Michigan, and Oklahoma. Its products address needs for product protection, high-temperature masking, finishing, and packaging across various industrial applications.

PMI emphasizes a customer-service model that guarantees a live person answers every call during business hours, positioning this responsiveness as a core differentiator. The business markets itself as "American owned, American made, American proud," and highlights quick turnaround on quotes and shipments.
